contentPattern.structure: per card: thumbnail image + headline + Read Article CTA

suitableFor: 4-up news or resource card rows with image + headline + read-more link
editorial content promos on a light background
notSuitableFor: compact icon + label navigation tiles (use cards-category)
icon + title + description feature rows (use cards-feature)
colored promo cards with body copy (use cards-promo)
